jobs.title: Sr. Director, Engineering - US Money Movement
jobs.description:
ADP is seeking a Senior Director of Engineering to lead the U.S. Money Movement organization.

This leader will oversee a global team of approximately 80+ engineers responsible for the development, modernization, resiliency, and production health of platforms supporting the collection and disbursement of funds for ADP clients, employees, agencies, and third parties. The role combines engineering leadership, platform ownership, operational accountability, and cross-functional partnership. The successful candidate must be able to lead a mission-critical technology organization while balancing platform stability, modernization, product delivery, risk management, and client commitments.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering leadership

Lead, develop, and scale a globally distributed organization of approximately 80+ engineers.
Build a strong leadership bench across engineering management, architecture, data, DevOps, and production support.
Establish clear priorities, accountability, and operating rhythms across multiple teams.
Attract, retain, and develop high-performing technical and leadership talent.

Platform strategy and delivery

Own the engineering strategy and technology roadmap for U.S. Money Movement.
Ensure the reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability of high-volume financial transaction platforms.
Continue modernizing the platform following its migration to AWS and upgrade to SAP S/4HANA, B/4HANA, HANA, and modern Linux infrastructure.
Reduce technical debt, simplify architecture, and modernize integrations.
Advance automation, observability, DevSecOps, data engineering, and software delivery practices.
Balance strategic transformation with near-term product and operational priorities.

Operational resiliency

Maintain end-to-end accountability for the production health of a Tier 1, mission-critical platform.
Strengthen resiliency, disaster recovery, monitoring, capacity management, and incident response.
Partner with Operations and business teams to meet payment-processing deadlines and client commitments.
Provide executive leadership during critical incidents and ensure root causes are addressed through durable corrective actions.
Use operational metrics and incident trends to drive continuous improvement.

Business, risk, and financial leadership

Partner with Product, Operations, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and business leaders.
Translate business priorities into a coherent technology strategy and investment roadmap.
Ensure engineering practices and controls meet financial, regulatory, security, audit, and enterprise-risk requirements.
Manage a significant technology portfolio, including labor, infrastructure, software licensing, vendors, consultants, and support contracts.
Communicate complex technical and operational matters clearly to executive and technical audiences.

Scope

The organization supports core money movement processing, SAP financial capabilities, data and analytics, bank connectivity, payment integrations, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, production support, reconciliation, and enterprise integrations.

The platform operates at substantial scale, supporting hundreds of thousands of clients, tens of millions of workers, and annual transaction flows measured in trillions of dollars.

This role will be based out of our San Dimas, CA location. We are working in a hybrid work environment, working out of the office 3 days a week with the opportunity of working from home the other 2 days.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience.
12+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, application development, or enterprise technology.
8+ years leading engineering organizations, including managers and senior technical leaders.
Experience managing a large, globally distributed engineering organization.
Proven ownership of mission-critical, high-availability transaction platforms.
Experience leading major cloud migrations, platform modernizations, or architectural transformations.
Strong knowledge of software engineering, systems integration, data platforms, DevOps, and production operations.
Experience managing significant budgets, vendors, and technology investment portfolios.
Demonstrated ability to lead through high-impact incidents and make sound decisions under pressure.
Strong executive communication and cross-functional leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in payments, payroll, banking, treasury, or regulated financial systems.
Experience with SAP S/4HANA, HANA, or comparable enterprise financial platforms.
Experience operating large-scale applications in AWS.
Familiarity with ACH, wires, real-time payments, SWIFT, bank integrations, and reconciliation.
Knowledge of financial controls, cybersecurity, audit, compliance, and disaster recovery.

Leadership Profile

The Successful Candidate Will

Act as the owner of a critical business service.
Balance modernization with operational stability and disciplined execution.
Simplify complex technical and organizational problems.
Build strong teams while maintaining clear accountability.
Communicate transparently with executives, engineers, and business partners.
Make decisions based on client impact, business value, risk, and long-term platform health.

You'll Love Working Here Because

Be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.
Belong by joining one of nine Business Resource Groups to connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.
Grow your career in an agile, fast-paced environment with plenty of opportunities to progress.
Continuously learn through ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities.
Be your healthiest. Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
Focus on your mental health and well-being. We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
Join a company committed to giving back and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live.
Get paid to pay it forward. Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Technology Development
jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

Oura is seeking a Senior Director, Technology Development to lead the manufacturing technology roadmap for the next generation of Oura products. This leader will connect Product Design, Industrial Design, Hardware Engineering, Materials, Quality, Sourcing, Operations, suppliers, and contract manufacturers to turn emerging technologies into scalable, repeatable production capabilities.

The role will build a technology development model that engages early in product definition, strengthens design for manufacturability, and creates reusable process platforms across programs. The initial focus areas are battery technology, zirconia and other brittle materials, PVD coatings, molding and encapsulation, and manufacturing automation.

This is a hands-on executive role requiring strategic leadership, deep technical judgment, supplier and factory engagement, and the ability to move technologies from concept through production.

What you will do

Own a multi-year roadmap for battery manufacturing, zirconia/brittle materials, PVD, molding/encapsulation, automation, and adjacent capabilities.
Build and lead a multidisciplinary team of senior engineers, technology developers, and subject-matter experts.
Establish reusable “golden processes” and technology platforms that improve yield, reliability, cost, cycle time, capacity, and launch speed across products.
Partner early with design and engineering teams to influence architecture, materials, tolerances, specifications, and process choices.
Create a disciplined development funnel from opportunity identification and experimentation through qualification, early validation, NPI, and ramp.
Lead supplier and contract manufacturer engagement, including process development, equipment selection, qualification, capability improvement, and scale-up.
Set technical readiness standards, maintain roadmaps and risk registers, and communicate clear investment recommendations to leadership.
Identify and protect proprietary manufacturing methods, process know-how, and other intellectual property.

Technology focus areas

Partner with battery, PD, electrical, quality, and supplier teams on cell architecture, energy density, safety, dimensions, tolerances, manufacturability and reliability.
Qualify new cell technologies, materials, suppliers, assembly methods, and automation, with robust controls for critical-to-quality characteristics.
Lead development of brittle material, forming, machining, sintering, finishing, inspection, and handling capabilities.
Improve yield, durability, cosmetics, and cost while establishing material specifications, process windows, failure-mode understanding, and qualification methods.
Drive DFM and design-for-process reviews with design teams, suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
Advance PVD capabilities for functional and cosmetic requirements, including cleaning, pretreatment, buffer layers, masking, color control, adhesion, wear, corrosion, and rework.
Partner with ID CMF and PD to balance appearance, durability, capability, and cost.\
Own the roadmap for injection molding, epoxy molding, encapsulation, sealing, tooling, and dispensing.
Improve process windows, tooling, materials, equipment, and controls to deliver high yield, water-tightness, dimensional stability, and cosmetic quality.
Reduce defects including leakage, voids, incomplete fill, component damage, contamination, and cosmetic fallout.
Develop next gen molding processes and tooling to achieve the minimization, efficient encapsulation, high yield and faster turnaround.
Define the right level of automation across assembly, battery processing, molding, inspection, testing, kitting, and material handling—balancing quality, speed, flexibility, capital, and risk.
Lead automation from concept through equipment specification, supplier selection, buyoff, installation, qualification, ramp, and sustaining.
Advance robotics, machine vision, AOI, error-proofing, digital work instructions, process monitoring, and automated data capture.

What success looks like

A clear, funded roadmap aligned with product and manufacturing strategy.
Earlier, stronger technology and DFM input into product architecture.
Reusable process platforms that reduce launch risk, development time, and reinvention.
Improved capability and yield across battery, zirconia/ brittle material, PVD, molding, and automated operations.
Faster transition from technology demonstration to qualified production.
Stronger supplier capability, equipment standards, data systems, documentation, and intellectual property.
A trusted expert team that is effective across Product, Engineering, Quality, Sourcing, and Operations.

What you bring

15+ years in technology development, advanced manufacturing, process engineering, supplier industrialization, or a related field in consumer electronics, wearables, medical devices, semiconductors, or similarly complex products.
Proven experience building and leading multidisciplinary teams across materials, processes, equipment, and automation.
Deep expertise in several of the following: batteries, zirconia or brittle materials, PVD/coatings, molding/encapsulation, automation, precision assembly, or high-cosmetic manufacturing.
A track record of taking technologies from concept and experimentation through supplier qualification, NPI, ramp, and sustained improvement.
Strong knowledge of DFM/DFA, DOE, process capability, measurement systems, failure analysis, reliability, qualification, and statistical process control.
Experience defining equipment and tooling strategies, selecting technology partners, and influencing global suppliers and contract manufacturers.
Ability to connect technical decisions to product experience, quality, schedule, cost, capacity, and business value.
Excellent communication skills with technical and executive audiences.
Willingness to travel internationally as needed.

Benefits

At Oura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Oura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and equity packages
Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
An Oura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
Paid sick leave and parental leave

jobs.description:
Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology

Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world.

Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:

Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.
Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.
Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

Ad Platforms is responsible for Disney's industry-leading ad technology and products – driving advertising performance, innovation, and value in Disney's sports, news, and entertainment content, across all media platforms.

Job Summary

The Sr. Manager, Foundations Engineering leads the day-to-day engineering execution, operational reliability, and platform delivery of the Foundations Engineering function within Ad Platforms - the internal capability layer that powers every service, application, and system in the organization. The organization owns and operates portions of the Ad Platforms infrastructure and developer platform stack directly, while also extending, operationalizing, and supporting shared enterprise platforms within the Ad Platforms ecosystem.

This includes leadership across platform engineering and DevOps, cloud infrastructure and runtime operations, SRE and reliability practices, database administration, observability enablement, and the infrastructure and platform capabilities supporting the Data Platform, BI ecosystem, and AI agentic and real-time ML platform. This role partners closely with centralized Platform Engineering and Infrastructure teams responsible for shared enterprise services and cloud platforms. This role reports to the Director, Product Software Engineering - AI Engineering + Foundations Engineering.

We are seeking a Sr. Manager who is deeply execution-oriented and operationally excellent - someone who thrives on building reliable, scalable systems, leading high-performing engineering teams through delivery, and improving platform quality and developer experience quarter over quarter. If you are a leader who takes pride in production stability, drives operational discipline without creating bureaucracy, and knows how to develop engineers while keeping the platforms running at scale, this is an exceptional opportunity.

Responsibilities And Duties Of The Role

Platform Engineering & DevOps

Manages and delivers the platform engineering and DevOps capabilities that power software delivery across Ad Platforms - including ownership and operational support of CI/CD systems, Kubernetes and container orchestration environments, Infrastructure-as-Code modules, deployment automation, shared cloud platform integrations across AWS (primary), Azure, and GCP, and internal developer tooling - improving deployment speed, reliability, scalability, and developer experience.
Drives automation-first operational practices, golden-path engineering patterns, self-service engineering capabilities, and Ads-specific platform abstractions built on top of shared infrastructure platforms - accelerating engineering velocity, reducing operational toil, and improving onboarding, deployment reliability, and release consistency across Ad Platforms teams.
Serves as a primary operational ownership layer for Ad Platforms workloads running on shared infrastructure and platform services - partnering closely with centralized Platform Engineering organizations responsible for core cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and observability platforms.
Implements and enforces secure-by-default platform standards across Ad Platforms environments and delivery pipelines - including secrets management, deployment governance, engineering quality gates, vulnerability remediation, auditability, and compliance controls - in partnership with Security and centralized infrastructure teams.
Develops internal developer tooling and web-based operational interfaces that support service deployment, runtime management, and engineering productivity across Ad Platforms.

Reliability, Data & AI Platform Infrastructure

Establishes and operates reliability engineering practices across Ad Platforms foundational services and runtime environments - including SLO/SLI frameworks, incident management rigor, production readiness standards, operational health monitoring, and resiliency engineering practices - driving measurable improvements in uptime, stability, and deployment confidence.
Leads observability operations and enablement across Ad Platforms - including logging, monitoring, distributed tracing, alerting frameworks, and operational instrumentation standards - partnering with centralized observability teams to ensure consistent and actionable visibility into system behavior and platform health.
Leads database engineering operations and data infrastructure enablement for Ad Platforms, including operational reliability, backup and recovery strategy, failover readiness, performance optimization, and modernization efforts across relational, NoSQL, and cloud-native data systems supporting transactional services, analytics, BI, and Data Platform workloads.
Builds and operates infrastructure and platform capabilities supporting AI agentic and real-time ML systems - including orchestration runtimes, inference platform enablement, GPU and compute orchestration, deployment automation, and governance-aligned operational frameworks - enabling AI Engineering teams to develop, deploy, and scale AI systems reliably and safely.
Executes FinOps and cost management practices across multi-cloud infrastructure and AI inference workloads - including capacity planning, cloud spend visibility, utilization optimization, waste reduction, and unit cost reporting - contributing to engineering efficiency and responsible resource utilization.
Leverages observability signals and automation to drive anomaly detection, incident prevention, and intelligent alerting across Ad Platforms services and platforms.

Team Leadership & Delivery

Leads, develops, and grows a high-performing engineering organization across Foundations Engineering's platform domains - managing engineers and technical leads directly, driving hiring and performance management, establishing execution cadence, and fostering a culture of operational excellence, accountability, continuous improvement, and engineering craft.
Owns delivery execution and roadmap commitments across Foundations Engineering domains - planning quarterly work, coordinating dependencies with AI Engineering, Product Engineering, Security, Data, and centralized Platform teams, leading postmortems and operational reviews, and continuously improving delivery predictability, production quality, and platform health.

Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training

10+ years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated depth in platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or related foundations disciplines.
Proven people management experience leading engineering teams - hiring, coaching, performance management, and building engineering delivery culture within a platform or infrastructure organization.
Strong cloud infrastructure and platform engineering expertise - AWS required (hands-on operational depth); Azure and GCP experience valued; Kubernetes and container orchestration, Infrastructure-as-Code, and CI/CD platform operations at production scale.
Demonstrated reliability engineering experience - SLO/SLI design, incident management, production readiness practices, and observability across high-availability, distributed systems.
Database engineering and operational data infrastructure experience - managing relational and cloud-native databases at production scale, with exposure to data platform infrastructure (lakehouse, streaming, or orchestration systems) a strong plus.
Familiarity with AI infrastructure and ML platform operations - inference runtimes, agent orchestration infrastructure, GPU/compute platform management, or operational AI platform support sufficient to lead effective teams in these domains.
FinOps and cost management discipline - tracking cloud spend, driving capacity efficiency, eliminating waste, and communicating cost tradeoffs clearly.
Strong cross-team collaboration and communication skills - able to coordinate effectively with AI Engineering, Product Engineering, Security, Data, Finance, and centralized Platform Engineering teams, and to represent Foundations Engineering planning and progress to senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in online advertising technology - familiarity with ad serving systems, programmatic platforms, campaign management, or streaming ad delivery infrastructure.
Experience building or contributing to an internal developer platform (IDP) - self-service engineering tooling, golden-path frameworks, platform abstractions, or developer experience improvements at scale.
Familiarity with Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Kafka, or similar cloud-native data platform technologies used in lakehouse or real-time streaming infrastructure.
Experience with AI/ML runtime infrastructure - vector databases, embedding pipelines, model serving, inference systems, or agent execution platforms.
Background in high-availability, high-scale real-time systems - live streaming, live advertising, event-driven architectures, or real-time bidding - operating across multi-cloud environments.
Demonstrated practice in automation-first operational models - reducing operational toil through tooling, scripting, platform engineering, and infrastructure automation rather than manual processes.

Required Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
